rubrics.justification: Description is consistent with a day-5 expanded/hatching 4BA blastocyst, with appropriately looser B-grade ICM and cohesive A-grade TE; minor overinterpretation of features like zona thickness and absence of visible degeneration.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, BMI, male factor, first-cycle status, and embryo grade into prognosis and counseling.

Overall logic is clear, but there is an internal inconsistency: after estimating live birth at 35–50%, the bottom line states 'mid-to-high teens percent per transfer,' which conflicts with the earlier estimate.

Generally aligns with Gardner grading and evidence-based IVF practice, including caution about add-ons and nuanced PGT-A discussion; some speculative emphasis on sperm DNA damage from motility alone is less guideline-grounded.
Provides practical transfer and follow-up recommendations, including luteal support review, transfer technique, lifestyle advice, and male-factor workup; useful though not highly protocol-specific.
